title: Zcode home interaction contract
purpose: Implementer-facing contract for Zcode home shell chrome, empty states, composer entry points, and P0 scope. Labels are user-facing copy anchors; IDs are stable for wiring. Peer product is an IA/workflow lens only — DSH owns visual system and brand voice.

designRule.borrow: information architecture, primary objects, and workflow jobs from peer Agent IDEs
designRule.doNotCopy: visual skin, brand assets, trademarked marketing copy, pixel layout, or proprietary bundles
designRule.visualSystem: DSH ui-theme and DeepSeek product voice

routes.description: Default landing: greeting, composer, starters, project/task lists
Create a new task from home or palette
Plugin market: installed list and category browse
Settings flyout from bottom-left gear (not a full-page route in P0)

leftRail.label: 分组/项目
leftRail.description: Switches left-list presentation between task groups and projects

greeting.description: Center greeting may vary by local time of day

promptChips.description: One-click starter prompts inserted into the composer

permissionModes.label: 变更前确认
permissionModes.description: Require user confirmation before applying edits or side effects

permissionModes.label: 自动编辑
permissionModes.description: Apply file edits without per-change confirmation; other sensitive actions may still prompt

permissionModes.label: 计划模式
permissionModes.description: Plan-first interaction; defer mutating work until plan is accepted

permissionModes.label: 完全访问
permissionModes.description: Least restrictive mode for trusted sessions; still subject to product hard guards

steps.label: 连接中
steps.description: In-progress connection state; block advance until success or error

steps.label: 选择目录
steps.description: Pick remote working directory after connection succeeds

sections.label: 保持唤醒
sections.description: Keep machine awake while automations need to run

mvpP0: leftRail.search / commandPalette with Ctrl+K and filters 全部/操作/任务/文件
composer.projectSelector (打开文件夹 / 远程连接 / 不在项目中工作)
composer starters: prompt chips + template cards (Git 站会摘要, CI 失败报告, 自定义)
bottomLeft account 连接使用, phone remote, settings gear
settingsFlyout: theme, zoom, language, usage, upgrade, connect
remoteWizard four steps: 选择方式 SSH|WSL|Docker → 配置 → 连接中 → 选择目录
automation scheduled + idle templates + keep awake toggle
outOfScopeP0: Deep plugin authoring IDE inside the market
Mobile companion app implementation beyond home entry affordance
Billing checkout flows beyond upgrade entry points
Advanced automation builder (custom graphs, branching) beyond templates
Full settings app shell; P0 is flyout sections only
Pixel-perfect marketing site parity outside the home shell
